import json,sys,subprocess
SC=["normal","mixed","partial-zero","empty","unknown","fail-fast","cancelled","live"]
base=json.load(open('/tmp/base.json'))
def run(path,args):
    inp = "\n" if args and args[0]=="live" else ""
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,path,*args],input=inp,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
    return p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr
ok=True
for k in SC+["<default>"]:
    rc,out,err=run('/work/batch.py',[] if k=="<default>" else [k])
    lines=err.splitlines(); recs=[json.loads(l) for l in lines]
    b=base[k]
    checks={
     "exit":rc==b[0],"stdout":out==b[1],"count":len(recs)==len(b[2]),
     "seq":[r.get("sequence") for r in recs]==list(range(len(recs))),
     "int":all(type(r["sequence"]) is int for r in recs),
     "fields":all({kk:vv for kk,vv in r.items() if kk not in("sequence","elapsed_ms")}=={kk:vv for kk,vv in o.items() if kk!="elapsed_ms"} for r,o in zip(recs,b[2])),
     "keys":all(list(r)[:-1]==list(o) and list(r)[-1]=="sequence" for r,o in zip(recs,b[2])),
     "elapsed_int":all(type(r["elapsed_ms"]) is int for r in recs),
     "one_summary":[r["event"] for r in recs].count("summary")==1}
    ok&=all(checks.values())
    print(k,rc,[(r["event"],r["sequence"]) for r in recs],"" if all(checks.values()) else checks)
# invalid scenario + per-invocation reset
for path in ['/tmp/batch_orig.py','/work/batch.py']:
